reviews.text:
I might be the wrong demographic for this product. I am in my 40s and could have easily skipped over this cushion thinking it was aimed towards a younger audience but I am so glad I took a chance on it. 

It has a lovely satin finish as the name suggests, nothing too dewy or too matte. It works so well with my mature combination skin. It never sits in my pores or fine lines like the Tirtir Red Cushion did. 

The coverage is very natural but still covers the mild rosacea I experience. It last well throughout the day and looks fresh even hours later. 

The packaging is the main reason I selected this cushion. I liked the idea of a more hygienic option and felt it would last longer without drying up. I also love the idea that I can refill it. 

I already have purchased a refill as I am so impressed.
reviews.zh:
我可能唔係呢款產品嘅目標客群。我四十幾歲，本來好容易就會跳過呢款氣墊，以為佢係針對年輕客群，不過好高興我都畀咗個機會佢。

如名所示，佢有好靚嘅緞面光澤，唔會太水光，亦唔會太霧面。佢好啱我嘅成熟混合性皮膚。佢唔會好似 Tirtir Red Cushion 咁卡入毛孔或者幼紋。

遮瑕效果好自然，但係仍然可以遮蓋我嘅輕微玫瑰痤瘡（rosacea）。全日持妝都幾好，過咗幾個鐘都仲係睇落清新。

我最主要係因為包裝而揀呢款氣墊。我鍾意更衛生嘅選擇，而且覺得咁樣可以用得耐啲，唔會乾咗。我仲好鍾意可以補充裝嘅概念。

我已經買咗補充裝，因為我真係好滿意。

reviews.text: super bad angle! but as a 220 maybelline for reference i didnt know if this would fit me but it does! once you add all the makeup it makes a huge difference as well! it looks soo pretty and a satin finish on the skin, a good medium coverage which you can either build up once or just add a tiny but of concealer! really easy to work with and a great starter into cushions if not the one and done since you dont really have to find another after this one! definitely great for combo and oily skin since its not shiny and it lasts pretty well if you set with powder ! definitely recommend if you’re into buying one!
reviews.zh: 角度好差！不過參考一下，我用 Maybelline 220，唔知呢款啱唔啱我，但原來啱！加埋所有化妝之後，效果都好有分別！睇落好靚，皮膚上係緞面效果，遮瑕力中等，你可以疊一次加厚，或者加少少遮瑕膏！好易用，如果想入門用氣墊，呢款都係一個好好嘅起步選擇，甚至可以一用到底，因為之後你唔使再搵其他產品。混合性同油性皮膚用都好好，因為佢唔會油光，如果用散粉定妝，持久度都幾好！如果你想買一款，我一定推薦！

reviews.text:
It's my first cushion foundation ever and first foundation in general cause it's really hard for me to find a perfect shade as I'm very pale and everything looks too yellow or orange on me:( so I was really nervous if I picked the right shade
I was either gonna pick 18C or 21N but 18C seems to have pink undertone (i don't know much about makeup so i hope what i'm saying makes sense😭) and I think those products looks good on me so I decided to pick shade 18C and it's almost perfect! Just a little too bright but it doesn't look bad i think! And I love how you can control how much product you want to use <3 It also has a really good coverage :] Definitely my favorite!
reviews.zh:
呢個係我第一次用氣墊粉底，都係我第一次用粉底，因為我膚色好白，搵返啱嘅色號好難，又會覺得乜嘢都好黃或者好橙 :( 所以我好緊張會唔會揀錯色號。
我本來會揀 18C 或者 21N，但 18C 好似有粉紅底調（我唔係好識化妝，希望我講嘅嘢幾明白 😭），而且我覺得嗰啲產品睇落幾啱我，所以最後揀咗 18C，而家幾乎啱啱好！只係有少少太亮，但我覺得都唔差！我好鍾意可以控制用幾多產品 <3 遮瑕力都好好 :] 絕對係我嘅最愛！

reviews.text: I love this compact so much. It's pretty cool to be able to push the side button and a see the makeup come out through the holes. The puff applicator leaves an even distribution of the makeup and is also easy to clean. The finish of the makeup is more satiny than matte, so I do have to use a setting powder only because I have oily skin in some areas. I carry this in my to-go makeup bag for emergencies or if I need a touch up. I got it in shade 23W Bisque, and it's a perfect match. Definitely recommend!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢個粉盒。推側邊個掣，睇到化妝品由個細孔度推出嚟，好靚、好酷。粉撲塗抹器可以令化妝品分佈得好均勻，而且好易清潔。妝效更似緞面而唔係霧面，所以我一定要用定妝粉，因為我有啲位置會出油。我會帶住佢喺袋入面，以備不時之需或者補妝。我揀咗 23W Bisque 嗰個色，好啱我，絕對推薦！

reviews.text:
I am in awe over this. 
as someone who previously stood by romand bare water cushion foundation the Unleashia one tops it EASILY!
doesn’t look cakey even with power. in terms of coverage, would say it is on the higher end of medium (WAY better than romand). 
it’s on the matte side but still honestly looks quite natura with a slight glow.
this stuff STAYS even without any sort of setting powder which is frankly so impressive.

I am not sure why this isn’t more popular tbh. great design, great formula. WOW
reviews.zh:
我真係好驚艷。
我之前一直都支持 Romand Bare Water 氣墊粉底，但 Unleashia 呢款完全超越佢！
就算撲粉都唔會浮粉。遮瑕力嚟講，我會話係中等偏高（比 Romand 好太多）。
佢偏霧面，但係真係睇落幾自然，帶少少光澤。
呢款嘢就算唔撲定妝粉，都可以持久，真係好厲害。

我唔明點解佢未夠受歡迎，老實講。設計好，配方好。WOW

reviews.text: This is my first cushion foundation I've ever tried and I was worried about the shade range. I'm quite pale, so I was winging it. I am happy to say, compared to my current favorite foundation, this is an even better match! It's lightweight and easy to apply, feels hygienic with the button feature, I adore that it's refillable. This is something I plan on throwing in my purse and taking everywhere with me from now on!
reviews.zh: 呢個係我第一次試氣墊粉底，我本來好擔心色號範圍。我膚色好白，所以係估住揀。好開心可以話，同我現時最鍾意嘅粉底比較，呢款仲啱色！質地輕盈，容易推開，按鈕設計令我覺得好衛生，我好鍾意可以補充裝。呢款我以後會放入手袋，時時帶住出門！

reviews.text:
Shade 23W
This was the first compact I’ve ever purchased and I have to say, it’s the best thing I’ve spent money on.
My skin type is combo (VERY oily around t-zone, sometimes dry patches appear, even my nose can get dry, very textured skin, SENSITIVE, acne scars/pigmentations…you know the drill)
The reason why I bought this in the first place because it was green but the product is AMAZING. Sometimes I struggle finding a good base make-up because most matte foundations feel too dry and dewy foundations leave me looking like I’ve just went for a swim. This foundation however covers up ALL of my pigmentations, evens out my textured skin and give me a subtle glow without feeling greasy. It also feels extremely comfortable on the skin and somehow hydrates my dry patches? like they literally disappear…
Even though I love the satin look, I am a matte girly so I always top it off with huda beauty powder and it’s CHEFS KISS.
One thing to note, I was trying out some concealers and found out that it didn’t really mix well with Covergirl’s Trueblend Undercover concealer (completely separated my base).
ALSO tried this out for 6 months so yeah it’s great go buy it.
reviews.zh:
色號 23W
呢個係我第一個買嘅粉餅，我要講，係我最值得花錢買嘅嘢。
我嘅膚質係混合性（T 字位好油，有時又會有乾燥嘅斑塊，連鼻都會乾，皮膚紋理好粗，屬敏感肌，有暗瘡疤同色素沉澱……你明白嘅）。
我當初買呢款，係因為佢係綠色嘅，但係產品真係好正。有時我好難搵到好嘅底妝，因為大部分霧面粉底都會覺得太乾，而水潤嘅粉底又會令我好似啱啱游完水咁。不過呢款粉底可以蓋住我所有色素沉澱，平滑我粗糙嘅皮膚，又會有少少光澤，唔會覺得油膩。搽落皮膚上都非常舒服，而且唔知點解，會令我嘅乾燥斑塊水潤咗，好似即刻消失咁……
雖然我好鍾意緞面效果，但我係霧面派嘅人，所以我一定會撲 Huda Beauty 散粉做收尾，效果就係一流！
有一點要留意，我試過一啲遮瑕膏，發現佢同 Covergirl Trueblend Undercover 遮瑕膏唔係幾夾（直接令我嘅底妝分開咗）。
另外，我用咗六個月，所以係，真係好好，快啲去買啦。

reviews.text: I love how this cushion change thw cushion game. I love cushions but the sad part is, I cannot use cushions for retouching makeup due to the possibility that it will harbor bacteria if u double dip the puff if you need to retouch your makeup when your out & about. But this compact change the cushion game, it is super hygienic. I love the formulation too. It is semi-matte but it will give you the right glow. I will definitely purchase the refill
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款改寫咗氣墊玩法。我好鍾意氣墊，但係令人傷心嘅係，我唔可以喺外出補妝時用氣墊，因為如果重複蘸粉撲，有機會滋生細菌。不過呢款粉盒改寫咗氣墊嘅玩法，好衛生。我都好鍾意佢嘅配方。佢係半霧面，但會帶出啱好嘅光澤。我一定會買補充裝。
